calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-22-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: James Robertson, Clerk: S.Vantree, CSR: B. Fields, #7235

Petitioner Qinghong Shi was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined. Petitioner's sister Fei Shu Draper, present, sworn and interprets English/Cantonese on petitioner's behalf.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Yu Xin Sally Shi.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: James Robertson, Clerk: S. Vantree, CSR: B. Fields, #7235

Petitioner Qinghong Shi, mother was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor Yizhou Xu. Petitioner's sister Fei Shu Draper, present, sworn and interprets English/Cantonese on petitioner's behalf.

Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.

Minor's father was not present, Court proceedings heard.

Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Yizhou Eddy Guo
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
